summary: Frontend tests of the 3 approved follow-ups all passed. (1) The Privacy Notice paragraph privacy-notice-align-sharing matches the approved text exactly. It is the element right after privacy-notice-who-can-see, inside section #collect. Headings are numbered 1-4 in order. No horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390. (2) The v8 version bump works: parent2 and parent1 each saw the 'Before you continue' screen once on login. Continue stayed disabled until both boxes were ticked. After continuing they landed on /dashboard, and the screen did not come back on later pages. (3) parent2 (not linked): the Account Align card says 'Not linked' and has no comm-share-row or comm-share-switch. Saving /prep/communication went straight to /next-steps/comm_style with no comm-share-card. PUT communication-readiness as parent2 returned 409 'Link your account to SACOparentsAlign first.' (4) parent1 (linked): the Account card shows comm-share-row and comm-share-undecided while the choice is null. Switch on showed a toast and stayed on after reload (API choice=yes). Switch off showed a toast and stayed off after reload (choice=no). With choice=no, saving /prep/communication went straight to /next-steps/comm_style with no dialog. Unlink was not clicked.

ui_bugs.issue: After saving, the next page keeps the old scroll position (scrollY was 839), so the user lands near the bottom of the next-steps page instead of the top. Minor, probably pre-existing.
